title: Contain a bad release before it reaches every request
description: Inject a release or infrastructure failure, choose the rollout shape, and toggle readiness, rollback, and topology controls. Kubernetes replaces Pods; the release contract decides whether users stay protected.

incidents.label: Dependency readiness regression
incidents.detail: The candidate process starts, but cannot reach a required downstream dependency.

incidents.label: Input-specific code bug
incidents.detail: Only a slice of production requests fails, so process health remains green.

incidents.label: Zone drain during rollout
incidents.detail: A failure domain disappears while candidate Pods are still replacing the baseline.
